name: HAT-P-20
description: Star of 4,595 K, 71 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Bakos et al. 2010, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-20 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: HAT-P-20 b crosses HAT-P-20 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Bakos et al. 2010.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname BAKOS_ET_AL__2010): st_teff 4595, st_rad 0.694, st_mass 0.756

quotes.title: HAT-P-20
quotes.card: HAT-P-20 is a K-type main-sequence star about 233 light-years away.
quotes.introduction: The star has a strong starspot activity, and its equatorial plane is misaligned by 36+10−12° with the planetary orbit.
